question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH track_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
  FROM Track
),
track_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds,
    t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 as duration_minutes,
    ts.min_ms,
    ts.max_ms,
    ts.avg_ms,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (ts.min_ms + ts.avg_ms) / 2.0 THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (ts.avg_ms + ts.max_ms) / 2.0 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t
  CROSS JOIN track_stats ts
)
SELECT 
  tc.category,
  ROUND(MIN(tc.duration_minutes), 2) as min_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(tc.duration_minutes), 2) as max_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity, 0)), 2) as total_revenue
FROM track_classified tc
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON tc.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY tc.category
ORDER BY 
  CASE tc.category 
    WHEN 'Short' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'Long' THEN 3 
  END

-- Verify total revenue across all categories matches InvoiceLine total
WITH track_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
  FROM Track
),
track_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (ts.min_ms + ts.avg_ms) / 2.0 THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (ts.avg_ms + ts.max_ms) / 2.0 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t
  CROSS JOIN track_stats ts
)
SELECT 
  tc.category,
  COUNT(il.InvoiceLineId) as num_purchases,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity, 0)), 2) as total_revenue
FROM track_classified tc
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON tc.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY tc.category
